interpretation: Among butterflies with the same number of resolved hosts, greater introduced-host geographic resource gain is associated with more added regions supported by multiple recorded hosts.
claim_boundary: Both axes are derived from the same underlying plant range unions. The association can be a mathematical and spatial-coverage effect. It is not a causal tradeoff, demographic insurance result or an independently validated ecological process. Evaluate against the plant-family x continent geography-constrained introduction null before making strong claims.
